tasks.short: Plan and administer biological research programs

steps.what: Collect and check current project milestones, approved budgets and staff availability
outputs: Checked program planning inputs with unresolved gaps marked

steps.what: Choose research priorities and develop the actual program plan within available resources
outputs: Working scientific program and proposed resource allocations

steps.what: Compare proposed allocations and milestones against the supplied resource ceilings and date constraints
outputs: Exact constraint comparison with conflicting allocations flagged

steps.what: Resolve scientific and resource conflicts with project leads and administer agreed program changes
inputs: Project leads' actual progress and concerns
outputs: Agreed changes and unresolved decisions captured in the working plan

steps.what: Complete the actual program plan and check its final allocations, dates and decision status
outputs: Complete final program plan with checked decision status

steps.what: Save the checked final program version in the existing project record
inputs: Exact final program plan checked in s5
outputs: Saved program record with its actual approval status

tasks.design: Configure {PROJECT}, {ERP} and {HCM} views for the program's actual planning inputs, then use native {SPREADSHEET} constraint checks on the proposed allocations. The biologist chooses priorities, resolves conflicts and checks the complete final {DOCS} plan before saving its exact version in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changing project, budget and availability records require repeated collection and manual cross-checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing saved views, formula checks and document fields can cover the repeated handling when the source systems permit access.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific priorities, competing resource claims and credible project commitments require the people responsible for the research.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist weighs research value and negotiates a workable program.

ambition.what: Revisit program allocations when material resource constraints change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for finance, staffing and project-data consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved project views and spreadsheet formulas can expose exact budget, availability and milestone conflicts without choosing scientific priorities.

assumptions: This is an unmeasured program-planning and administration episode, not a claimed duty mix for every biologist. Shares describe its actual work, independent of the prompt prior.

Project leads maintain milestones, finance supplies approved budget figures and staffing owners supply authorized availability. Their source capture remains their existing work; s1 counts the biologist's collection and verification. Missing or stale sources require manual follow-up, not inferred figures.

s3 replaces actual manual constraint comparisons; it earns no additional saving where equivalent checks already run. s5 uses native fields for agreed changes and retains final scientific and allocation checking.

The program record is an internal working plan within delegated authority. A decision requiring another authority stays pending until that authority reviews the final version. This does not silently commit expenditure, change staff assignments or send notifications.
The same-system save is effectively immediate and earns no saving. Gross reduction is 19.8 hours per 100 baseline focal hours; 3 hours of incremental upkeep gives 16.8 net.
unknowns: Actual planning episode mix and manual comparison effort
Source access and existing constraint checks
Which allocations require an additional final decision maker
research_questions: Which comparisons are still performed by hand?
How often are availability inputs stale?

already_counted.description: Retained source collection, conflict discussions and final plan checking

incremental.description: Maintain source views, resource rules and field mappings; periodically compare checks with actual program changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete program plan and decision status checked in s5; any edit requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured conditional estimate: source collection saves 2, exact comparisons 15, plan completion 2.8; gross 19.8 minus 3 upkeep = 16.8 net. Existing equivalent automation or scarce comparison work lowers the result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and critically read relevant published evidence for the actual species and research question
inputs: OTHER: scholarly literature catalogue and reference manager
outputs: Checked relevant evidence and source identifiers

steps.what: Design and conduct the actual authorized biological study and observe species reactions
inputs: Actual authorized study plan and applicable oversight
outputs: Direct observations of species reactions under the approved study

steps.what: Capture and verify actual observation identities, conditions and measured reactions
inputs: Actual observations and instrument files from s2
OPS_SYSTEM: existing biological study notebook and sample registry
outputs: Checked source observations linked to actual study and sample identifiers

steps.what: Stage the checked source observation fields into the study analysis table using exact identifier mappings
inputs: Explicit study and sample identifier mapping
outputs: Staged observation table and unmatched-field list

steps.what: Check the complete observation table, analyze reactions and write the actual scientific interpretation
outputs: Complete checked study findings and interpretation with limitations

steps.what: Save the checked final findings in the existing study notebook
inputs: Exact final study findings checked in s5
outputs: Saved findings linked to the actual study

tasks.design: Configure saved literature searches in {OTHER} and a native field import from the actual {OPS_SYSTEM} study notebook into {SPREADSHEET}. The biologist conducts the study, captures observations, checks the complete imported table and writes the scientific interpretation in {DOCS} before saving the final study record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated literature retrieval and rekeying observation fields interrupt the scientific work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference searches and exact notebook exports can remove repeated retrieval and transcription when these remain manual.
tasks.still_hard: Authorized study design, biological observation, confounding factors and interpretation remain scientific work.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist distinguishes measured reactions from unsupported explanations.

ambition.what: Improve handling of existing study evidence; no expansion of experimental activity assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for study-data and notebook access consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference-manager searches and exact notebook field exports can reduce retrieval and repeated transcription while leaving study conduct and interpretation with scientists.

assumptions: This is an unmeasured observation-study episode with actual notebook-to-analysis rekeying, not a universal baseline. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.
s2 includes actual study design, applicable authorization and physical study work. This proposal supplies no experimental protocol, biological parameters or new automated organism handling.
s3 counts the biologist's actual observation capture and source verification. No clean dataset is assumed free. Missing identifiers or source conflicts stop s4 and require manual resolution in s5.

s4 is the explicit proposed machine action. Existing instrument acquisition, calculation runtime and any existing equivalent notebook import are baseline; already linked records earn no new import saving. s5 retains complete table checking, actual analysis and the written findings.

No separate report, publication, external send or additional post-study paperwork is invented. Actual study recording and findings are shown once. Same-system saving takes effectively no time and earns no saving.
Gross reduction is 5 literature-handling hours plus 10 transcription hours per 100 baseline focal hours. Deduct 3 incremental upkeep hours once for 12 net.
unknowns: Actual source formats and current notebook integration
Time spent retrieving versus reading papers
Share of studies that require manual observation transfer
research_questions: Which source fields are genuinely rekeyed today?
Can the native import preserve identifiers and expose unmatched fields?

already_counted.description: Retained source capture, complete table checking and scientific interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain literature searches and study-field mappings and test imports against source observations

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete observation findings and interpretation checked in s5; changed findings must be checked again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 gross minus 3 upkeep = 12 net per 100 baseline focal hours. Benefits depend on actual retrieval and transcription work; existing equivalent imports reduce them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Project leads supply actual progress and resolve program constraints.
Finance and staffing owners provide authorized source records.
skills_to_grow: Check observation provenance and notebook imports
role.ambitious_version: A biologist who spends less time transferring research records while retaining scientific design, observation, interpretation and program accountability.
